datasets.name: EgoBlind
datasets.expected: 1,392 videos (EgoBlind train 673 + test 656 downloadable here; 5,311 questions)
datasets.license: CC BY-NC 4.0 (external/EgoBlind/LICENSE); non-commercial research, education and evaluation; cite the paper; attribute video sources (data/egoblind/meta/video_source.csv)
datasets.split: official train / test; the official train clips are split by whole source recording (video_source.csv; overlapping rows merged), targets train 70% (imitation, P-CACS tuning), finetune 15% (REINFORCE), select 5% (checkpoints, thresholds), holdout 10% (unseen test, never used for training or selection), realised 67.5 / 15.5 / 5.1 / 11.4%; clips without a source row go to train; 4 clips sharing a recording with the official test are excluded; no recording on two sides (scripts/egoblind_common.py); the official test is an external held-out benchmark never used for tuning
datasets.used_by: weak communication events, replay evaluation, scheduler training (models/egoblind*), recall diagnosis
datasets.missing: test videos: Google Drive per-file quota throttles the shared zips; scripts/download_egoblind.py --all retries
